analysis_cohort.note: 12 Jsoup evaluation bugs with accepted Jev A-001 WAF gaps are excluded from headline metrics for every method (paired denom=113). Listed in README.
analysis_cohort.excluded_reason: A-001 OpenRouter WAF blocked complete Jev shortlist scoring

semantics.per_bug_row: Each Random row stores the mean of each metric over 1000 permutations for that bug; first_trigger_rank and detected_at_* may be fractional.
semantics.linear_cohort: FDR/MRR/mean APFD/mean NFTR = arithmetic mean of the 113 per-bug Random rows.
semantics.median_nftr: For replicate i, use permutation i for every headline bug; take the cohort median NFTR; report the mean of those 1000 medians.
semantics.cdf: Average of 1000 replicate empirical CDFs on a 0.00..1.00 grid.
semantics.do_not: Do not take median of per-bug mean NFTRs for the headline median NFTR; do not pick a single lucky permutation.
